config.script:
lunchpopupname="Project/Pop-Up/Lunch"
	messagepoupname="Project/Pop-Up/Pop-up"
	if self.view.params.label == "Supervisor Assistance":
		checkAssistance=system.tag.readBlocking([self.session.custom.machineInfo.basePath+"/Supervisor/Assistance_requested"])
		if checkAssistance[0].value ==True:
			params = {"action": "error", "primaryText": "Supervisor Already notified!", "secondaryText":" "}
			system.perspective.openPopup("PopUp", view = messagepoupname, 
										params = params, 
										showCloseIcon = False,
										draggable = False, 
										modal = True)
		else:	
			params = {	"action": "confirm",
					"primaryText": "Please confirm you want supervisor assistance!",
					"secondaryText":" Supervisor will be notified about the assistance requirment","label":"Notify"}
			system.perspective.openPopup("PopUp", view = lunchpopupname, 
											params = params, 
											showCloseIcon = False,
											draggable = False, 
											modal = True)
	elif self.view.params.label == "Log Downtime":
		system.perspective.navigate(page="/opr_downtime_entry")
#	elif self.view.params.label ==  "Downtime Monitor":
#		system.perspective.navigate(url="http://localhost:8088/data/perspective/client/Hitachi_Energy_Transformer/sup_downtime_monitor")
	elif self.view.params.label ==  "Break":
		params = {	"action": "confirm",
				"primaryText": "Please confirm you want to go for a Break !",
				"secondaryText":" You will be logged out from the current session once you press confirm.",
				"label":self.view.params.label}
		system.perspective.openPopup("PopUp", view = lunchpopupname, 
										params = params, 
										showCloseIcon = False,
										draggable = False, 
										modal = True)
	elif self.view.params.label ==  "Lunch":
		shiftdata=system.tag.readBlocking(["Current_Shift/Start_time","Current_Shift/End_time"])
		startTime=shiftdata[0].value
		endTime=shiftdata[1].value
		params={"startTime": startTime,"endTime": endTime,"MachineID": self.session.custom.machineInfo.ID}
		result = system.db.runNamedQuery( "downtime/CheckActiveLunch",params)
		LunchExists = result.getValueAt(0, "LunchExists")   
		if LunchExists == 1:
		    params = {"action": "error", "primaryText": "Lunch Already taken for the shift!", "secondaryText":" "}
		    system.perspective.openPopup("PopUp", view = messagepoupname, 
										params = params, 
										showCloseIcon = False,
										draggable = False, 
										modal = True)
		else:
			params = {	"action": "confirm",
					"primaryText": "Please confirm you want to go for Lunch Break !",
					"secondaryText":" You will be logged out from the current session once you press confirm.",
					"label":self.view.params.label}
			system.perspective.openPopup("PopUp", view = lunchpopupname, 
											params = params, 
											showCloseIcon = False,
											draggable = False, 
											modal = True)
